html: II. חרר (√ of foll.; Arabic حَرَّ be or become free, حُرٌّ free, freeborn; NH חרר Pi. set free, חֹר freeman; Aramaic חֲרַר, ܚܰܪ Pa. set free, חֹרָא, חָרְתָּא freed-man, -woman; Sab. חר freeman, noble(?) DHMEpigr. Denkm. 57; Ethiopic ሐራ coll. army, troops (in Amhar. free, noble, according to Di85), ሐራዊ free, noble, etc.)
